Dear Mi Shri, 💗

I don't always know how to put everything I feel into words, but I hope you can feel it in the little things I do. You have become such a beautiful part of my life. Your presence makes ordinary days feel special, and even a small moment with you can become a memory I want to keep forever. I love your smile, your little ways, your warmth, and all the things that make you you. I don't need us to be perfect. I just want us to keep choosing each other, understanding each other, laughing together, and growing together. I want to be the person you can come to when the day feels heavy, the person who celebrates your happiness like it's my own, and the person who reminds you that you never have to be perfect to be loved. I'll keep trying to love you with honesty, patience, respect, and effort—not just through beautiful words, but through the way I treat you every day. Thank you for being you, Shri. Getting to love you is one of my favourite surprises life has given me. 🥹❤️
Always yours, Nikhil ♡
